parser.scope: module/version/record/rule subset admitted by current G9 EBNF; research proxy, not production parser

scientific_result: Bounded support for separating source/contract, canonical program semantics, lowering and executable artifact identities. A semantic hash copied onto pre-canonical Source/Parse stages must not be treated as independently minted semantic authority; canonical typed IR should be the derivation point, with earlier stages carrying source/parse identities and optionally a non-authoritative expected semantic reference.
counterhypothesis: A single monolithic source/contract hash plus final execution receipt is sufficient and layered identities add complexity without improving stale-cache prevention, replay correctness or diagnosis.
falsifier: Production Ubuntu compiler/Harness differential tests show no correctness, replay, cache-invalidation or diagnostic advantage from layered identities, or show that the proposed derivation boundary causes unacceptable repair/cost overhead.
